host.description: Network interface to bind to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces or 127.0.0.1 for localhost only).

port.description: Port number on which MOM listens for client connections.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for client connections (recommended for production).

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (required if TLS is enabled).

tls_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (required if TLS is enabled).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

log_dir.description: Directory where MOM writes log files.

log_max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a single log file before rotation (100 MB default).

log_backup_count.description: Number of old log files to retain after rotation.

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads for message processing.

max_queue_size.description: Maximum number of messages held in memory per queue before applying backpressure.

message_ttl.description: Default Time-To-Live (in seconds) for messages (24 hours default).

allowed_networks.description: List of allowed client IP subnets (CIDR notation); empty list means allow all clients.

ldap_url.description: LDAP server URL for authentication (used only if auth_provider = 'ldap').

ldap_base_dn.description: Base Distinguished Name (DN) for LDAP user searches.

persistence_enabled.description: Persist messages to disk for durability and recovery.

persistence_dir.description: Directory used for persistent message storage.

max_size.description: Max messages this queue may hold before backpressure.

ttl.description: Per-queue message TTL (seconds); defaults to global message_ttl if omitted.

dead_letter_queue.description: Name of the DLQ to which failed messages are routed.

replication_peers.description: List of peer MOM nodes for replication (used in HA setups).

host.description: Hostname or IP of the replication peer.
